title: Recombinant Expression and Purification of LSAM Domain of Human Legumain in E. coli
author: Dahms, Wieland, et al.

steps.title: Prepare growth media
steps.instruction: Make 2 L TB medium (8 × 250 mL in 2.5 L shaker flasks) and at least 25 mL LB medium in a 250 mL flask, autoclave both and cool to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Transform cells and start overnight culture
steps.instruction: Thaw 80 µL chemocompetent BL21(DE3) cells on ice, add 20 µL 5× KCM solution and 100 ng plasmid DNA, incubate on ice 10 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 30 s, add 500 µL LB medium and incubate at 37 °C for regeneration, shake 1 h at 800 rpm, transfer to 25 mL LB with 30 µg/mL kanamycin (1:50 dilution), and grow overnight (≈16 h) at 37 °C, 200 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare all required buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare every buffer listed in the Materials section, store at the indicated temperatures, and make urea‑containing buffers fresh and keep at 4 °C to avoid carbamylation.

steps.title: Lyse cells and isolate inclusion bodies
steps.instruction: Thaw bacterial pellets at room temperature, add 1 mL of 30 mg/mL lysozyme in Ni‑buffer A per tube, resuspend each pellet in 30 mL Ni‑buffer A (per 500 mL culture), add 1 mM CaCl₂ (30 µL of 1 M stock), 2.5 mM MgCl₂ (75 µL of 1 M stock) and a spatula tip of lyophilized DNase (~5 000 U/mg), rotate 1 h at room temperature, cool 10 min on ice, sonicate on ice at 25 % power, 20 % cycle (200 ms pulse, 800 ms brake) for 3 min, repeat sonication 4 times mixing between runs, centrifuge 17 500 g, 4 °C, 10 min and discard supernatant, then centrifuge again 17 500 g, 4 °C, 2 min and discard residual supernatant.

steps.title: Wash non‑classical inclusion bodies
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 30 mL Ni‑buffer A at room temperature, centrifuge 17 500 g, 4 °C, 10 min, discard supernatant, centrifuge 17 500 g, 4 °C, 2 min, discard residual supernatant, and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Resolvise inclusion bodies in urea buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed NCIBs in 30 mL ice‑cold solubilisation buffer (62.5 % Ni‑buffer A + 37.5 % urea buffer, final urea 3 M), rotate at 4 °C overnight (≈16 h), centrifuge 17 500 g, 4 °C, 10 min, collect the supernatant containing the solubilised PC1pro‑LSAM fusion protein in a 50 mL Falcon tube, and use immediately for Ni²⁺‑affinity purification.

steps.title: Equilibrate Ni‑NTA column and load sample
steps.instruction: Prepare 200 mL Wash buffer 1 (2 % Ni‑buffer B in Ni‑buffer A, 10 mM imidazole), 50 mL Wash buffer 2 (4 % Ni‑buffer B, 20 mM imidazole) and 30 mL Elution buffer (50 % Ni‑buffer B, 250 mM imidazole). Equilibrate 5 mL Ni‑NTA resin (10 mL of 50 % slurry) with two 25 mL washes of Wash buffer 1 by gravity flow. Add 0.6 mL Ni‑buffer B to the solubilised protein to bring it to 10 mM imidazole, mix, resuspend the Ni‑NTA resin in 10 mL Wash buffer 1 and add to the protein, then resuspend the remaining resin (stuck to the column wall) in another 5 mL Wash buffer 1 and add to the protein. Incubate the mixture at 4 °C for 30 min with rotation.

steps.title: Wash and elute protein from Ni‑NTA
steps.instruction: Collect the Ni²⁺‑beads by gravity flow into the column, use a pipette boy to speed flow, wash beads stuck in the glass bottle with 25 mL Wash buffer 1, shake, pour into column and empty; repeat this wash step twice. Then wash the column with 50 mL Wash buffer 1 followed by 50 mL Wash buffer 2, each time emptying by gravity flow. Elute bound protein by sequentially adding 3 mL, 10 mL, 5 mL and another 5 mL of Elution buffer, allowing each volume to flow slowly by gravity. Freeze elution fractions at –20 °C until further use. (Optional: analyse fractions by SDS‑PAGE, measuring UV280 and loading 2.5 µg of the highest‑concentration fraction.)

steps.title: Anion‑exchange chromatography of LSAM domain
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a Source 15Q (2 mL) anion‑exchange column at 0.5 mL/min with 5 % IEX‑buffer A (50 mM NaCl) until a stable baseline is reached. Load the Ni‑NTA eluate onto the column using a suitable loop (e.g., 10 mL), collecting flow‑through in 2 mL fractions (do not exceed 30 mg total protein). Wash with 5 % IEX‑buffer A at the same flow rate, collecting 2 mL fractions. Elute sequentially: (i) increase NaCl to 8.5 % (first elution) at 0.5 mL/min, collect 0.5 mL fractions until UV280 returns to baseline; (ii) increase NaCl to 25 % (second elution) at 0.5 mL/min, collect 1 mL fractions until baseline; (iii) increase to 100 % IEX‑buffer B (third elution) at 0.5 mL/min (≈10 min), collect 1 mL fractions until baseline. Analyse all fractions by SDS‑PAGE, measure UV280, determine the volume needed for 2.5 µg protein from the highest‑concentration fraction and load onto gel. Pool fractions containing the isolated LSAM domain and freeze if desired.

steps.title: Concentrate and store purified LSAM
steps.instruction: Pool the LSAM‑containing IEX fractions, concentrate them with an Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter (MWCO 3 kDa) to ≈1 mL (≈2 mg/mL). Measure the protein concentration by UV280 and adjust to a final concentration of 5–10 mg/mL. Aliquot 20 µL into thin‑walled PCR tubes and store at –20 °C.
